## Overview

In this midterm for ENVS 193DS, I worked with two datasets to practice 
statistical communication, data visualization, and reproducing analyses. 
I used R with tidyverse, janitor, rstatix, and gt packages to analyze 
California halibut landings and bee pathogen loads across habitat types.
